original_wording: Generic 'consider individual needs' → too generic; memo.
observed_problem: Coders disagree whether SEND 'inclusive and accessible' overview language is support_present=1 / rung 2.
revised_wording: Clarify: support_present=1 only if a named support/role/device/plan type is specified; generic inclusivity/accessibility exhortations remain support_present=0 and at most rung 1.
rationale: Operational clarity; matches existing negative example intent.

observed_problem: Ambiguity whether any plan testing / drills count as rung 4 or only tests of occupant executability (incl. diverse needs).
revised_wording: PROVISIONAL: rung 4 requires testing of whether prescribed protective actions can be carried out under realistic conditions; mere familiarisation drills without executability focus remain rung 1 unless text ties drills to verifying action performance. AFN-specific discrimination deferred to Phase B.
rationale: Prevents automatic inflation of all drill language to rung 4; still provisional vs comparator.
effect_on_prior_coding: Phase A mixed codes retained with provisional memos

observed_problem: Optional lessons-learned / illustrative case studies may or may not count as rung 5.
revised_wording: PROVISIONAL: rung 5 requires that the framework states or structurally requires that testing/exercise findings are used to revise the measure/plan. Optional 'may' language and non-binding illustrations are memo'd and not finalized without Phase B.
effect_on_prior_coding: Phase A provisional rung 5 retained with flags

observed_problem: PAI / PEEP mentions during exercises: support vs attention language.
revised_wording: Operational: PEEP/PAI as named plan types → support_present=1 possible; 'attention particulière' alone → 0. Linkage may be unlinked. Final comparator discrimination of function-based vs plan-named supports deferred to Phase B.

original_wording: Do not infer silence from vague keep-noise-down
observed_problem: Entailing inhibitory acoustic from LOCKDOWN/HIDE labels without explicit silence.
revised_wording: Operational rule: do not code demand_inhibitory_acoustic=1 from protocol names alone; require explicit silence/stillness language or documented entailment-table trigger. Ambiguous cases → value 0 + ambiguous_memo only if memoing.

observed_problem: SSAT / physical-security assessment tools misreadable as rung 3.
revised_wording: Clarify: rung 3 is assessment of protective-action executability (can occupants carry out the action under stated conditions), not general security vulnerability assessment.

observed_problem: 'en la medida de sus capacidades' (staff capacity) misreadable as functional-diversity support.
revised_wording: Staff-capacity participation clauses are not D1 supports unless named accommodations for functional needs are specified.

observed_problem: P5 blocked complete pilot while P1-P4 available.
revised_wording: Two-phase pilot: Phase A operational (P1-P4); Phase B benchmark calibration (P5).
rationale: Access constraint before coding; not outcome-dependent.

observed_problem: Consolidado HTML marks Norma derogada 11 Jul 2023 (RD 524/2023).
revised_wording: Hold for freeze: revisit CF-15 supersession/identity before corpus freeze; Phase A may use registered BOE PDF for procedural testing only.
rationale: Source stability; not a Phase A coding rule change.
